message.content: Mia Bonta (D), candidate for California State Assembly District 18, has a mixed record on the issues tracked here. On AB 715, the Assembly antisemitism-prevention bill, tracker records show her as a skeptic who pressured co-authors to "clean up" the bill after its late-night passage in September 2025, yet Vote for Peace reports she ultimately voted for it after criticizing its rushed handling; the bill text does not explicitly name IHRA. In August 2023, she voted aye on the Assembly final passage of SB 403, the anti-caste-discrimination bill, a matter of low relevance to Gaza. CAIR Action lists her as "preferred" for the general election, Vote for Peace rates her "Ally" and marks her "supported," AROC Action endorsed her, and the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club endorsed her in the primary, a carry-forward into November 2026. Independent spending supporting her includes $21,031.94 from the Coalition for Patient Access and Innovation and smaller amounts from teacher unions, Courage California, the California Democratic Party, and We Vote, all with unestablished issue relevance. No TrackAIPAC, AIPAC, or opposing independent spending appears in the record.
